2105-4598-7296-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4598-7296-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4598-7296-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2104-2707-5497.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Hoverstone Pilgrim by paying {2}, causing you to put Temporal Manipulation on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

851-4365-6763-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

4222-5268-7938.description:
Activate Shuttle Ace by tapping it, adding {U}.
Shuttle Ace triggers, causing you to gain 2 life
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Shuttle Ace.
Repeat.

703-2726-7824.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying the Astral Dragon spell.
Resolve the copy of the Astral Dragon spell, putting one token copy of Astral Dragon onto the battlefield (note this is not "created" so it is not doubled).
When the Astral Dragon token enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, creating four token copies of TOKEN DOUBLER that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the original Astral Dragon spell from step 1.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating 64 token copies of TOKEN DOUBLER that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.

1895-4268-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Kor Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kor Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-4268-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

2488-6338-7167.manaNeeded: {7}{G}{G} plus {2}{W} if you don't control your commander
2488-6338-7167.description:
Cast Apex Altisaur by paying {7}{G}{G}.
When Apex Altisaur enters, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, cast Flawless Maneuver by paying its mana cost if you don't control your commander or casting it for free otherwise, giving creatures you control indestructible until end of turn.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing it to fight a creature you don't control.
If the opposing creature dealt damage to Apex Altisaur, Apex Altisaur's second ability and Wrathful Raptors trigger.
Resolve the Wrathful Raptors trigger, dealing damage to any opponent.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing it to fight a creature you don't control.
Repeat from step 4 until your opponents control no creatures. If they happen to control an indestructible creature with power above 0, this loop can be done infinitely.
2488-6338-7167.notes: You can restart the loop if opponents control creatures by dealing damage to Apex Altisaur. It may not have indestructible by this point however unless you use another source to provide it.

2685-4186-4321-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-4186-4321-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

321-399-2475-6707-7692.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {0}.
When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1368-1879-4289-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1879-4289-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2438-4302-5929.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2438-4302-5929.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Leyline of Transformation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-2762-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Thopter Squadron.
When Thopter Squadron dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

3459-4289-5078-5741.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

3499-4091-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate one of the Aphetto Alchemist tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Aphetto Alchemist token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2034-4488-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

539-5412-7037.description:
Cast Toph by paying its mana cost
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Toph
When Toph dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability.
Repeat from step 3.

465-2921-3817.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

5051-5078-5243-5268.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1661-1987-4131-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Basalt Monolith by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Basalt Monolith.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2034-2308-6719.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-6719.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Dazzling Angel trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1251-1550-4251.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any Samurai you control.
Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1251-1550-4251.description:
Declare Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Godo and the Samurai that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, causing you to exile Godo, then search your library for a basic land card and exile it, then put the land and Godo from exile onto the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

654-1170-2499-4124-5954.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-6103-6105.description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, causing you to choose how players vote this turn and drawing a card.
Cast Magister of Worth by paying {4}{W}{B}.
When Magister of Worth enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Magister of Worth and any number of other creatures, adding {2} for each one.
Resolve the Magister of Worth trigger, having each player vote for grace, returning all creatures from graveyards to the battlefield.
Repeat from 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

624-2438-5011.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3488-4131-4893.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
3488-4131-4893.description:
Activate Katsumasa by paying {2}{U}, causing Basalt Monolith to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

307-344-3542.notablePrerequisites:
Skullsnatcher and Palinchron do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Skullsnatcher or Palinchron.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{B}.
307-344-3542.description:
Declare Palinchron and Skullsnatcher as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Skullsnatcher from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is tapped and attacking.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Skullsnatcher's ninjutsu ability by paying {B} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Skullsnatcher onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Palinchron tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1379-1628-4186-4659.notablePrerequisites:
Necrosynthesis attached to Scurry Oak.
You control an additional creature.
1379-1628-4186-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
Necrosynthesis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Squirrel token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2978-4215-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bookwurm, adding {C}{C}.
When Bookwurm dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Activate Bookwurm by paying {2}{G}, putting Bookwurm from your graveyard into your library third from the top.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger from step 2, searching your library for Bookwurm and putting it onto the battlefield.
Bookwurm enters the battlefield, causing you to gain three life and draw a card.
Repeat.

257-1110-5038.description:
Cast Green Dragon by paying {4}{G}{G}.
Green Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Terror of the Peaks.
Resolve the Green Dragon trigger, causing any creature your opponent control that are dealt damage this turn to be destroyed.
Resolve the Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing damage equal to Green Dragon's power to any creature an opponent controls.
Green Dragon triggers, destroying the creature dealt damage.
The creature dies, triggering Overseer of the Damned's second ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
The Zombie enters the battlefield, triggering Terror of the Peaks, dealing damage equal to the Zombie's power to any creature an opponent controls.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another Angel you control

1169-3259-4302-4509.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block creatures you control.
You control an additional Angel.
1169-3259-4302-4509.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach it to another Angel you control, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the Angel dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token due to Divine Visitation.
When the Angel enters, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat each combat phase.

1193-1309-4095.notablePrerequisites: There are permanents on the battlefield that enter the battlefield untapped and produce at least {3}{R}{R}.
1193-1309-4095.description:
Cast Mythos of Illuna by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting anything but Salvager of Secrets.
In response, cast Radiate by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating copies of Mythos of Illuna that target each permanent besides the original target.
Resolve all copies of Mythos of Illuna besides the original, creating token copies of each permanent besides the original target.
The token copy of Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning Radiate from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the token lands or other mana-producing permanents created in step 3 by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2, doubling the number of copies created in step 3 each repetition.
